records.title: MIT Open Access Articles Understanding Communication Characteristics of Distributed Training
records.reason: Systematically analyzes communication patterns and overhead in distributed training and fits an analytical overhead model; a training-systems measurement study with no inference content.

records.title: E-mem: Multi-agent based Episodic Context Reconstruction for LLM Agent Memory
records.reason: E-mem reconstructs episodic context with multiple assistant agents instead of compressing memory for long-horizon LLM agents; agent memory architecture adjacent to inference context handling, but no serving/decoding technique.

records.title: T-REX: Hardware–Software Co-Optimized Transformer Accelerator With Reduced External Memory Access and Enhanced Hardware Utilization
records.reason: T-REX is a hardware-software Transformer accelerator minimizing external memory access with compression and dynamic batching, but it also introduces a factorizing training method and targets training as well as inference; mixed scope, not clearly an inference-system contribution.

records.title: Memory Reward Inflation in Self-Improving LLM Agents
records.reason: Shows stored self-assessment rewards inflate for incorrect episodes in memory-based self-improving LLM agents (the Echo Gap); an analysis of agent memory systems, not an inference technique.

records.title: Gated Condition Injection without Multimodal Attention: Towards Controllable Linear-Attention Transformers
records.reason: Builds controllable diffusion generation on linear-attention Transformers for secure on-device generation with gated condition injection; efficient architecture, but the target is image generation, not LLM inference.

records.title: PACT: Peak-Aware Cross-Attention Graph Transformers for Efficient Storm-Surge Emulation
records.reason: PACT is a peak-aware cross-attention graph Transformer that emulates storm surge from atmospheric forcing for coastal hazard assessment; a weather-prediction application, confirmed by the abstract.

records.title: On the Role of Attention Heads in Large Language Model Safety
records.reason: Studies the role of attention heads in LLM safety via mechanistic interpretability metrics; a safety analysis with no inference-system contribution.

records.title: CoSec: On-the-Fly Security Hardening of Code LLMs via Supervised Co-decoding
records.reason: CoSec hardens code LLMs at decoding time with a supervised co-decoding partner that steers away from vulnerable code; an inference-time decoding intervention, but for security rather than inference efficiency or serving.

records.title: Farewell to Aimless Large-scale Pretraining: Influential Subset Selection for Language Model
records.reason: Influence Subset Selection picks a tiny influential subset of the pretraining corpus using end-task gradient matching; pretraining data efficiency, not inference systems.

records.title: Is Model Attention Aligned with Human Attention? An Empirical Study on Large Language Models for Code Generation
records.reason: Empirically compares LLM attention with human programmer attention during code generation; an interpretability study with no inference-system contribution.

records.title: Comparative Study on Energy Consumption of Neural Networks by Scaling of Weight-Memory Energy Versus Computing Energy for Implementing Low-Power Edge Intelligence
records.reason: Compares how weight-memory versus compute energy scales for CNNs and LLM Transformers across batch sizes on edge intelligence; an energy measurement study relevant to inference deployment, but no new technique.

records.title: Less is KEN: a Universal and Simple Non-Parametric Pruning Algorithm for Large Language Models
records.reason: KEN is a non-parametric unstructured pruning algorithm for LLMs based on kernel density estimation that preserves significant parameters and stores only the optimized subnetwork; direct LLM pruning for deployment.

records.title: CE-LoRA: Computation-Efficient LoRA Fine-Tuning for Language Models
records.reason: CE-LoRA speeds up LoRA fine-tuning by approximating activation-gradient matrix multiplications; a fine-tuning efficiency method with no inference application.

records.title: Comparative Analysis of Model Pruning Approaches for Optimizing Small Language Models
records.reason: Compares WANDA, RIA and a hybrid pruning method on small language models for healthcare deployment; a comparative pruning study in an application sector, with no new serving system.

records.title: Vector Quantized Diffusion Model Based Speech Bandwidth Extension
records.reason: Uses vector-quantized diffusion over neural audio codec tokens for speech bandwidth extension; an audio signal-processing application, not LLM inference (the quantization is of audio features).

records.title: Implicit Graph, Explicit Retrieval: Towards Efficient and Interpretable Long-horizon Memory for Large Language Models
records.reason: LatentGraphMem stores graph-structured memory in latent space with explicit subgraph retrieval for long-horizon LLM QA; a memory-system design for context handling, adjacent to but not an inference execution technique.

records.title: Representative Attention For Vision Transformers
records.reason: Representative Attention compresses spatial tokens into representation-space proxies for linear global attention in Vision Transformers; an efficient attention variant for vision models, not LLM inference.

records.title: UltraViT: Latency-Optimized On-device Vision Encoder for Large Vision-Language Models
records.reason: UltraViT designs a pyramidal vision encoder explicitly optimized against measured on-device latencies for large vision-language models; direct inference-latency optimization of an LVLM component.

records.title: Second Thought: Reasoning in Parallel as LLM Agents Act and Observe
records.reason: Second Thought forks auxiliary reasoning branches that decode concurrently during ReAct action/observation idle windows and merges them back, relocating reasoning into otherwise wasted inference time; a direct inference-time execution framework.

records.title: Video Codec-Guided Training-Free Token Compression for Video Large Language Models
records.reason: Uses video codec motion vectors, residuals and reference dependencies as a cheap prior for training-free visual token compression in video LLMs; direct inference token compression for VLLMs.

records.title: Agent Memory as Recommendation: Recommender-System Design for Long-Term Memory of LLM Agents
records.reason: Formalizes long-term agent memory selection as budgeted slate recommendation under per-request cost budgets; a memory-retrieval design framing for LLM agents, not a serving or decoding system.

records.title: nanoLM: an Affordable LLM Pre-training Benchmark via Accurate Loss Prediction across Scales
records.reason: nanoLM predicts pretraining loss across scales via muScaling to benchmark LLM pretraining cheaply; training-research infrastructure with no inference content.

records.title: Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Decoder for Error-Correcting Codes
records.reason: A hybrid Mamba-Transformer decoder decodes error-correcting codes with layer-wise masking; a coding-theory application where 'decoding' is channel decoding, not LLM inference.

records.title: Sparse Fine-Tuning of Transformers for Generative Tasks
records.reason: Represents fine-tuned Transformer features as sparse combinations of dictionary atoms for interpretability of adaptation; a fine-tuning method/analysis, not inference systems.

records.title: zip2zip: Inference-Time Adaptive Vocabularies for Language Models via Token Compression
records.reason: zip2zip dynamically expands the active vocabulary at inference time with LZW-style hypertokens, shortening sequences and cutting LLM compute cost; a direct inference-time tokenization/compression method.

records.title: PRISM: Distributed Inference for Foundation Models at Edge
records.reason: PRISM distributes Transformer inference across edge devices using Segment Means approximations of intermediate features to slash inter-device communication, with restructured self-attention; direct distributed inference.

records.title: Tiled Bit Networks: Sub-Bit Neural Network Compression Through Reuse of Learnable Binary Vectors
records.reason: Tiled Bit Networks tile layers with learned binary vectors for sub-bit compression of binary networks; a general neural compression scheme, not evaluated as an LLM inference technique.

records.title: Deriving Coding-Specific Sub-Models from LLMs using Resource-Efficient Pruning
records.reason: Derives coding-specific sub-models from LLMs by resource-efficient unstructured pruning (Wanda) with domain calibration data; direct LLM pruning for cheaper deployment of code models.

records.title: TESU-LLM: Training Speech-LLMs Without Speech via Unified Encoder Alignment
records.reason: TESU-LLM trains speech-capable LLMs from text-only data via a unified encoder aligned to the LLM embedding space; a training framework for a modality capability, not inference systems.

records.title: BlockFormer: An Efficient Private Batch Transformer Inference With Homomorphic Encryption via Block Packing
records.reason: BlockFormer packs blocks to support scalable batching in homomorphically encrypted Transformer inference, improving private batch inference throughput; direct privacy-preserving inference system.

records.title: Two-Stage Fine-Tuning for Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models via Retriever and Prompt Optimization
records.reason: Two-stage fine-tuning of the retriever and prompt-tuning of the generator improves RAG answer quality; a training/prompt method for QA quality, not inference efficiency.

records.title: A Reinforcement Learning-Based Retraining-Free Pruning for Encoder-Based Language Models
records.reason: Proposes RL-based structured pruning of encoder language models without retraining, explicitly to reduce inference delay and model complexity; direct pruning for encoder-LM inference.

records.title: A Multi-Head and Multi-Level Attention Fusion Approach for Industrial Sci-Tech Achievement Classification with Large Language Model Enhancement
records.reason: MALTEC fuses multi-head/multi-level attention with LLM-generated keywords to classify industrial sci-tech achievements into regional policy categories; a document-classification application, confirmed by the abstract.

records.title: CoNNect: Connectivity-Based Regularization for Structural Pruning of Neural Networks
records.reason: CoNNect is a differentiable connectivity-preserving regularizer for structural pruning of general neural networks; a pruning-training method whose inference benefit is generic and not LLM-specific.

records.title: PEVLM: Parallel Encoding for Vision-Language Models
records.reason: PEVLM partitions long-video input into context blocks with a shared sink block to cut VLM prefilling attention complexity from quadratic to linear in frames; direct prefill efficiency for VLMs.

records.title: MegatronApp: Efficient and Comprehensive Management on Distributed LLM Training
records.reason: MegatronApp is a toolchain for managing, diagnosing and visualizing distributed LLM training on Megatron-LM; training operations tooling with no inference content.

records.title: TOGGLE: Temporal Logic-Guided Large Language Model Compression for Edge
records.reason: TOGGLE uses signal temporal logic robustness to guide Bayesian search over layer-wise quantization and pruning configurations, compressing LLMs for edge deployment with formal behavior guarantees; direct LLM compression.

records.title: Variational Linear Attention: Stable Associative Memory for Long-Context Transformers
records.reason: Variational Linear Attention reframes linear-attention memory updates as regularized least squares with a self-limiting state norm for long contexts; an attention mechanism study with stability theory, not a serving system.

records.title: CUSUM-Shaped Inference-Time Monitoring and Targeted Re-Decoding for Quantized Small Language Model Reasoning
records.reason: A CUSUM-shaped inference-time controller monitors quantized small reasoning models and, on alarm, restores an earlier token and KV-cache state for constrained re-decoding; direct inference-time decoding control for quantized models.

records.title: Accelerating Design Space Exploration for LLM Training Systems with Multi-experiment Parallel Simulation
records.reason: Multiverse is a GPU-based simulator accelerating design-space exploration of LLM training systems (parallelization, fabric, congestion) up to 54,000 GPUs; training-system simulation only, no inference content.

records.title: Does Self-Attention Need Separate Weights in Transformers?
records.reason: A shared-weight self-attention BERT learns one QKV matrix, halving parameters and cutting training time; parameter sharing is compression-adjacent, but the work is an architecture/training study, not an inference technique.

records.title: ALW: Adaptive Layer-Wise contrastive decoding enhancing reasoning ability in Large Language Models
records.reason: ALW contrasts layer-wise probability distributions during decoding to reduce noise accumulation and improve reasoning; a decoding method, but aimed at answer quality rather than inference efficiency or serving.

records.title: Half-S: Halving the Scale for Near-Lossless 4-Bit LLM Training
records.reason: Half-S derives optimal FP4 scaling to train LLMs at 4-bit precision near-losslessly; training quantization only, with no inference application stated.

records.title: Quantized LLMs for Clinical Report and Question Answering in Retinal Disease Assessment
records.reason: Fine-tunes a compact LLaMA for diabetic-retinopathy reports and QA and evaluates its Q4 GGUF quantization on CPU; an application deployment study of a clinical model, not a general inference technique.

records.title: Adaptive-VoCo: Complexity-Aware Visual Token Compression for Vision-Language Models
records.reason: Adaptive-VoCo predicts per-input visual token compression rates for VLMs, extending VoCo-LLaMA beyond a fixed rate to cut visual compute and memory; direct inference token compression for VLMs.

records.title: Text Compression Algorithm Based on Feedback Self-Optimization Using Lightweight LLMs
records.reason: A two-stage framework uses lightweight LLMs to select salient text units and regenerate compressed summaries; text summarization application where 'compression' is of documents, not of the model or its inference.

records.title: Enabling Resource-Efficient On-Device Fine-Tuning of LLMs Using Only Inference Engines
records.reason: Repurposes on-device inference engines (ExecuTorch) with zeroth-order optimization to fine-tune LLMs on edge devices; it exploits inference infrastructure, but the purpose is training/personalization, not inference efficiency.

records.title: AVAM: A Universal Training-Free Adaptive Visual Anchoring Embedded into Multimodal Large Language Model for Multi-Image Question Answering
records.reason: Adaptive Visual Anchoring compresses visual tokens for multi-image VQA in MLLMs with flexible token counts; token reduction serves a QA application and is framed as an accuracy-efficiency plug-in, not a serving system.

records.title: Toward an Unbiased Collective Memory for Efficient LLM-Based Agentic 6G Cross-Domain Management
records.reason: Studies retrieval bias in a shared collective memory for LLM agents doing 6G RAN-edge orchestration and defines a Retrieval Bias Index; agent memory analysis for a network-management application, not an inference system.

records.title: DCFT: Dependency-aware continual learning fine-tuning for sparse LLMs
records.reason: DCFT fine-tunes post-training-pruned sparse LLMs continually while preserving sparsity, treating interacting matrices jointly; it maintains an inference-relevant sparse model, but the contribution is a continual fine-tuning method.
